gloss: portrait of a beautiful woman; bijin-ga

definitions.gloss: portrait of a beautiful woman; bijin-ga
definitions.explanation: A genre of Japanese art, particularly in ukiyo-e woodblock prints, depicting beautiful women. The subjects are often courtesans, geisha, or fashionable women of the era.

examples.japanese: {美人画|びじんが}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する。
{喜多川歌麿|きたがわうたまろ}は{美人画|びじんが}の{名手|めいしゅ}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Kitagawa Utamaro is known as a master of bijin-ga.

examples.japanese: この{美術館|びじゅつかん}には{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}の{美人画|びじんが}が{数多|かずおお}く{収蔵|しゅうぞう}されている。
examples.english: This museum has a large collection of bijin-ga from the Edo period.

notes:
Composed of {美人|びじん} (beautiful woman) and {画|が} (painting, picture). One of the major genres of {浮世絵|うきよえ} (ukiyo-e) alongside {風景画|ふうけいが} (landscape paintings) and {役者絵|やくしゃえ} (actor portraits).

Famous {美人画|びじんが} artists include {喜多川歌麿|きたがわうたまろ}, {鈴木春信|すずきはるのぶ}, and {上村松園|うえむらしょうえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浮世絵|うきよえ}の{美人画|びじんが} (ukiyo-e bijin-ga)
- {美人画|びじんが}の{傑作|けっさく} (masterpiece of bijin-ga)
- {美人画|びじんが}を{描|えが}く (to paint bijin-ga)
